tmua_chen_customs.note: James Chen's four custom TMUA papers: two written in 2025 before he sat the test, two more in 2026. 20 MCQs and 75 minutes each. Sittable in the app's exam simulator at /exam as jc_25_p1, jc_25_p2, jc_26_p1, jc_26_p2 (app/server/papers.js is the registry). Chen prints full worked solutions at the BACK OF THE SAME PDF — there is no separate mark scheme, so paper and solutions are one file. Classified into mock_tag_index.json as families JC_P1/JC_P2; never source questions from memory, always read the pages. Transcribed content lives in tutor_data/exams/questions/jc_<yy>_p<n>.json. Chen describes the 2026 pair as deliberately whimsical, with some questions off the TMUA specification — those carry off_spec in the index.

p1_meta.description: Mixes paper-1 techniques with paper-2 logic and proof rather than separating them. Written while Chen was Year 12 at Reading School.

p2_meta.description: Mostly paper-2 material: logic, proof, necessary and sufficient conditions. Chen warns many questions are deliberately ridiculous.

p1_meta.description: Chen's 2026 return, written from Cambridge. Techniques-led, with a running Gaussian-integral joke. Video solutions: https://youtu.be/bWZAR-4nn5U

p2_meta.description: Chen's 2026 paper 2: logic and proof, several questions self-referential or off-spec. Video solutions: https://youtu.be/bVUcgQIypdk

tmua_chen_customs.source: James Chen (Reading School, now reading Mathematics at Cambridge)

tmua_heracles_mocks.note: Heracles TMUA mock sets 1-3, two papers each (120 MCQs). Filed under the spelling on the papers' own covers, Heracles; the files arrived named Hercules and every note of the student's uses that spelling, so 'hercules' is kept as a tag/alias and canonical.js resolves both to HER-<set>-P<paper>-Qnn. Separate worked-solutions PDF per paper (filed as MS). Registered in app/server/papers.js as her_s<set>_p<paper>. Answer keys are in tutor_data/exams/answers/ (all 120 read from the solutions PDFs) and all 120 questions are classified into mock_tag_index.json as families HER_P1 / HER_P2. NOT transcribed: read questions off the pages, never from memory.

tmua_euclid.note: TMUA Euclid mock sets 1-4, two papers each, plus a one-off "R2Drew edition" Paper 1 — 180 MCQs in all. Registered in app/server/papers.js as euc_s<set>_p<paper> and euc_r2drew_p1, and sittable in the /exam simulator. Each numbered set ships a full worked mark scheme that prints "Answer: option X." at the end of every solution, so all 160 answers are read directly (tutor_data/exams/answers/). Classified into mock_tag_index.json as families EUC_P1 / EUC_P2. NOT transcribed: read questions off the pages, never from memory. Two quirks of the R2Drew edition: it has NO mark scheme at all, and it has SIX options per question (A-F) whose labels are drawn with a broken font subset, so they print as R 2 D r E W — read them as A B C D E F in that order.

tmua_jz_mocks.note: JZMaths TMUA mock sets A-E (major exams/tmua/jz/set-a..set-e), two papers each (200 MCQs). Solutions PDFs are the JZ mark schemes (answer letter, Tags/Difficulty line, worked solution). Classified into mock_tag_index.json as families JZ_P1/JZ_P2 (never into the official MAT/TMUA indexes); never source questions from memory, always read pages. Transcribed content lives in tutor_data/exams/questions/jz_<set>_p<n>.json.
